body: The Android fix spec is written: docs/specs/android-e2e-defect-fixes.md passes check_spec with 0 findings, and android-e2e-defect-fixes.items.json has 38 Steps and passes check_items.U+000AU+000AThe first interphase:spec-reviewer pass raised 19 issues.
